OpenSearch Ingestion supports the following Data Prepper plugins:
Sources:
• DocumentDB
• DynamoDB
• HTTP
• Kafka
• Kinesis
• OpenSearch
• OTel logs
• OTel metrics
• OTel trace
• S3
Processors:
• Add entries
• Aggregate
Supported plugins
92
Amazon OpenSearch Service

• AWS Lambda
• Convert entry type
• Copy values
• CSV
• Date
• Delay
• Decompress
• Delete entries
• Dissect
• Drop events
• Flatten
• Geo IP
• Grok
• Key value
• List to map
• Lowercase string
• Map to list
• Mutate event (series of processors)
• Mutate string (series of processors)
• Obfuscate
• OTel metrics
• OTel trace group
• OTel trace
• Parse Ion
• Parse JSON
• Parse XML
• Rename keys
• Select entries
• Service map
Supported plugins
93
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
• Split event
• Split string
• String converter
• Substitute string
• Trace peer forwarder
• Translate
• Trim string
• Truncate
• Uppercase string
